body:
## Summary

The iOS session composer and transcript are not usable for normal-length messages when the keyboard is open.

Physical-iPhone smoke found:

- The authoring field remains effectively single-line instead of growing upward with its content.
- Entered text becomes hidden behind the keyboard/composer.
- There is no obvious way to dismiss the keyboard and recover the transcript viewport.
- The keyboard plus stacked session chrome leaves only a small strip of chat visible.
- A completed assistant response appeared truncated or unreachable in the transcript.
- Backgrounding and returning to the chat did preserve the session.

The duplicate/oversized session headers are already tracked by #1235; this issue is specifically the keyboard, composer, scrolling, and complete transcript behavior.

## Expected interaction

- The composer begins immediately above the keyboard/safe area.
- It grows upward for multiline content to a sensible maximum height.
- Longer drafts scroll internally while preserving the caret and selection.
- The transcript remains independently scrollable.
- The keyboard can be dismissed with a standard gesture and an obvious accessible control.
- Complete assistant responses remain persisted, rendered, and reachable after streaming, keyboard changes, backgrounding, and reconnect.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Composer supports multiline input and grows upward from the keyboard/safe area.
- [ ] Composer caps at a defined height and becomes internally scrollable for long drafts.
- [ ] Draft text, caret, send action, and model/agent controls remain reachable with the keyboard shown.
- [ ] Users can dismiss the keyboard by interactive drag/tap behavior and an accessible keyboard action.
- [ ] Transcript can scroll to every message and the final line of every assistant response.
- [ ] A regression test distinguishes transport/storage truncation from view clipping and proves the full server transcript is rendered.
- [ ] Background/foreground and reconnect preserve the complete draft and transcript without duplication or truncation.
- [ ] Physical-iPhone smoke passes with a long multiline prompt and a long streamed response.

## Context

- Found during #1199 physical-device smoke for PR #1165.
- Core chat capability: #1172.
- Related layout cleanup: #1235.
title: iOS: make the chat composer keyboard-safe, multiline, and preserve the full transcript
